authorization: Continue the partition-function explanation after rejecting the configuration-level positive pair relaxation.
question: Can record-sector Hellinger information plus exact omitted parity mass tighten the certified L5,p=.08 LER interval?
design_role: Cheapest prerequisite before a new connected-cluster construction. It preserves posterior sector competition instead of relaxing to configuration pairs.
frozen_model: Same canonical square, ternary current prior, public interior integer charge, rough endpoints and logical parity as the completed activity contract.

method.truncated_records: Enumerate all currents with activity <=4 and retain Z0^(4)(Q),Z1^(4)(Q).
method.hellinger: H_4=sum_Q sqrt(Z0^(4)(Q) Z1^(4)(Q)). Bayes LER is at most the full Hellinger coefficient.
method.exact_residual_parity: For m logical-cut edges, the full odd-parity mass is [1-(1-2p)^m]/2. Subtract the truncated sector masses to obtain R0,R1 exactly.
method.remainder: By sqrt((a+r)(b+s))<=sqrt(ab)+sqrt(as)+sqrt(br)+sqrt(rs) and Cauchy, H<=H_4+sqrt(A0 R1)+sqrt(A1 R0)+sqrt(R0 R1).
method.combined_interval: Keep the activity lower bound and the minimum of 1/2, activity upper and the Hellinger-remainder upper.

acceptance: Full L3 Hellinger coefficients upper-bound the frozen exact LER values; residual masses vanish within 1e-12.
Every L5 residual sector mass is nonnegative and reconstructs the exact logical-parity prior within 1e-10.

Promote the bound only in cells where it reduces the registered activity interval width by at least 10%. If no p=.08 cell passes, reject this remainder relaxation and move to a controlled connected-cluster feasibility contract.
No midpoint, threshold, phase, CFT or decoder claim.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen matrix. Do not increase k or size in response to failure.
decision: Reject the sector-Hellinger global remainder. It improves none of eight L5 cells; at p=.08 its bounds .42049,.40883,.37181,.35756 all exceed the activity bounds .13836,.12506,.11404,.10877.
next_action: Register a controlled connected-cluster feasibility test; do not increase activity order or reuse either failed global relaxation.
